title: On the Trustworthiness Landscape of State-of-the-art Generative Models: A Survey and Outlook
reasoning: The paper includes a significant focus on ethics and morals as core dimensions of 'trustworthiness.' Section 5 (Fairness) and Section 6 (Responsibility) specifically review the ability of models to operate within 'ethical and moral frameworks' and handle 'moral dilemmas' and 'social norms.' This is presented as a major pillar of the survey's taxonomy, rather than just a brief consideration.
